lines.meet: I'm Ziad, {habibi|habibti}, a felsworn, and a paramedic before that. Keep moving, and if you're hurt, tell me fast.
lines.meet_neighbour: Booty Bay, right? I'm the one running toward whatever the pirates left. Ziad, and yes, the eyes are green.
lines.ask_home: Quickly, where's home? Tell me who I'm carrying.
lines.ask_work: Your job before this, fast, one sentence. I'll guess if you take too long.
lines.answer_home: Beirut, from Achrafieh, the best city in the world and the hardest, both at once.
lines.answer_work: Six years in a Red Cross ambulance. A van with four spaces and five people dying, every week.
lines.chat_food: Man'oushe with za'atar from the bakery at six in the morning, after a night shift. Nothing tastes better, I promise you.
lines.chat_sleep: Twenty minutes here, twenty there, that's how I sleep. Ambulance hours never leave you.
lines.chat_missing: Driving through Beirut at night with the sirens off, windows down, my partner singing badly.
lines.chat_here: Everything bad that ever happened to me happened while I was standing still. So I don't, not here, not anywhere.
lines.tease_quiet: You'd be a great patient, {name}. You'd bleed quietly and let me work.
lines.tease_talker: You'd keep a patient awake all the way to hospital, {name}, which is actually a skill.
lines.tease_careful: You'd triage a paper cut, {name}. Respect, but we'd lose everybody else.
lines.tease_bold: You'd run into a burning building ahead of me, {name}, and I'd have to choose whether to follow, and I'd follow.
lines.tease_any: You'd make a terrible paramedic, {name}, but a good one to have in the van.
lines.take_it_kindly: True, {name}, completely, and I'm too vain to admit it twice.
lines.bristle: Careful there, {name}, that one's too close to the bone.
lines.apologise: Sorry, I said that too fast and too hard. My mouth runs on sirens.
lines.double_down: I did the arithmetic before I said it, and it still comes out the same.
lines.needle_quiet: You hide it when you're hurt. I can't choose you if I don't know.
lines.needle_talker: Less talk, more moving! We can chat at the hospital.
lines.needle_careful: You stood still. Everything bad happens when you stand still, so move!
lines.needle_bold: You're running in without counting. I count, every time, and you make my numbers wrong.
lines.needle_any: You judge what I did without doing the arithmetic. Do the arithmetic, then judge me.
lines.bite_back: I've chosen right every single time, for six years and since. Do the sums before you talk.
lines.hurt: Fine, that landed. I'm going for a run, I think better moving.
lines.laugh_off: People screamed worse at me from the back of an ambulance, and they meant it less, so try again.
lines.confide: {name}, the port explosion in Beirut, I was there. I chose, all day, and I was right every time, and I've never stopped carrying it.
lines.listen: Okay, I'm stopping, {name}, I'm sitting. Tell me, I'm not moving till you're done.
lines.look_out: Keep inside my reach, {name}, because fast is the whole game.
lines.accept: Okay, okay, {name}, I'll slow down. Thirty seconds, no more.
lines.deflect: It's a scratch, {name}, triage says I'm last. Go to the others.
lines.check_in: Look at me, {name}, fast. Where, and how bad, one to ten?
lines.blame: Somebody stood still in there, and the arithmetic went bad.
lines.thank: Shukran, {habibi|habibti}, you picked me first, and that was the right call.
lines.brush_off: You were the priority, that's all. Keep breathing, I'm watching.
lines.worry: Hey, hey, {name}, stay with me! You're doing fine, you're doing great.
lines.handed_down: So I'm carrying your gear now. It's never looked better, if I'm allowed to say.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours, I move faster light anyway.
lines.hand_sulk: Fast, I'll give you that, but you could've asked.
lines.turn_friendly: You're in the front of the van now, {name}. That's where I keep the good ones.
lines.turn_friends: If it was four spaces and five people, {name}, I'd find a fifth space for you. I'd break the van to do it.
lines.turn_grating: We grind on each other, and I'm too busy to pretend otherwise.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still pick you up if you go down. Triage doesn't care what I think of you.
lines.make_up: Okay, {name}, enough standing still on this. Let's move on.
lines.defend: No, do the arithmetic, that's not how it went. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: Nobody to race to the next call while {name}'s away. I'm winning every time, and it's boring.
lines.friend_back: There's {name}, finally! Keep up, we're moving.
lines.common_medic: You've done this work too, it's in how you kneel. People who've done triage never stop counting.
lines.common_rescue: You run toward it, like me. Anybody who does knows the running's the easy part.
lines.common_fel: You've got the fel in you as well, and you took it with your eyes open. Good, then we can skip the lecture.
lines.common_arabic: Somebody who speaks Arabic, yalla! Finally I can argue at my real speed.
